name: DocketBot
description: Back office tools for Washington State Misdemeanor Public Defense Attorneys. Hours of work done for you, only $30/month!
pricing: 30-day free trial, then $30/month. No credit card required for the trial, and you can cancel any time (licenses renew via Stripe).
tour: Open DocketBot and watch it assemble the folders, documents, and records for you.
Sign in to court portals yourself. DocketBot waits patiently while you enter your credentials.
Review and edit client details before printing waivers and your final docket PDF.
Print your single-PDF docket, walk into court, and focus on advocacy instead of admin.

faq.question: What does DocketBot do?
faq.answer: DocketBot reads from court websites and automatically creates, saves, and organizes relevant case files.

faq.question: Is this a cloud service?
faq.answer: No. DocketBot is a Windows desktop app. You choose where you store your files.

faq.question: Do you store my court credentials?
faq.answer: No. You sign in manually. DocketBot only automates the tedious clicks once you are logged in.

faq.question: Which courts are supported?
faq.answer: DocketBot is built around dw.courts.wa.gov and jabslink.courts.wa.gov for Washington State.

faq.question: How much does it cost?
faq.answer: The DocketBot license costs $30/month, after a 30-day free trial. There is no credit card or payment information needed for the free trial.

faq.question: Can I cancel any time?
faq.answer: Yes. Licenses renew via Stripe and can be canceled at any point.

body.text: DocketBot is a Windows desktop application you run locally, not a webpage or a cloud service. It reads from the Washington Courts and JABS websites, waiting for you to sign in manually so there is no password sharing.

items: Creates a folder structure of your misdemeanor clients.
Maintains a current and accurate spreadsheet of client names and case numbers for required reporting and conflict checking.
Downloads and saves individual client criminal history and driving record as PDFs in the client folder.
Generates prefilled waiver/reset forms from your PDF template.
Generates a single PDF by court date of all scheduled clients' documents for easy preparation and printing.
Runs locally on Windows; reads from WA Courts and JABS and waits for you to sign in manually, so no password sharing.

body.text: See how DocketBot fits into your existing workflow, preparing your docket for you without changing how you sign in or how you practice.

name: ClientCheck
description: Automatically check JIS for clients that have new charges following a blood test result. Hours of work done for you, only $30/month!
pricing: 30-day free trial, then $30/month. Cancel any time (licenses renew via Stripe).
tour: Open ClientCheck and watch it check new case filings against all of your clients for you.
Sign in to JIS yourself. ClientCheck waits patiently while you enter your credentials.
Save hours of manual searching, and receive emails from ClientCheck when a new case is found.

faq.question: What does ClientCheck do?
faq.answer: ClientCheck reads from JIS and automatically searches for each of your clients, and sends you an email when a new case is filed.

faq.question: Is this a cloud service?
faq.answer: No. ClientCheck is a Windows desktop app.

faq.question: Do you store my court credentials?
faq.answer: No. You sign in manually. ClientCheck only automates the tedious clicks once you are logged in.

faq.question: Is Seattle Municipal Court supported?
faq.answer: Yes! ClientCheck is built around jislink.courts.wa.gov and supports all courts that list filings there.

faq.question: How much does it cost?
faq.answer: The ClientCheck license costs $30/month, with a 30-day free trial.

faq.question: Can I cancel any time?
faq.answer: Yes. Licenses renew via Stripe and can be canceled at any point.

body.text: ClientCheck is a Windows desktop application you run locally, not a webapp or cloud service. It waits for you to sign in, so there is no password sharing.

items: Reads from your .csv of clients, automatically navigates the JIS website, and emails you when new charges are found.
Runs locally on Windows and waits for you to sign in manually, so there is no password sharing.
Supports jislink.courts.wa.gov, including Seattle Municipal Court.

body.text: See how ClientCheck fits into your existing workflow, checking new case filings for you without changing how you sign in or how you practice.
